# Query key canonicalizer

Public interface: sortQueryEntries in src/query-order.cjs.

sortQueryEntries(pairs) takes an array of string pairs and returns a new array of pairs in URLSearchParams.sort() order. Use the documented key comparison and stability rules, including non-ASCII keys. Keep duplicate entries and do not change the input pairs. Explain why sorting the values of equal keys is incorrect.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URLSearchParams/sort

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
